sources.name: TCGplayer market price, via TCGCSV
sources.note: Daily copy of TCGplayer's own price data. Market price is TCGplayer's figure for what a card has recently sold for. The lowest asking price is the cheapest TCGplayer listing at that time, in any condition and before shipping; it is a starting point, not a price you are sure to get.

sources.name: Price history before Sept 16, 2026, via Rarebox
sources.note: A public copy of older daily TCGplayer prices, used once to fill in our price history from June to mid-September 2026. Single cards only. On days when a card had no market price, it uses the middle asking price.

sources.name: eBay sold prices and prices by condition, via PokeTrace
sources.note: eBay sold prices for ungraded cards, and TCGplayer prices by condition, each with the number of sales. Looked up for the current picks only. eBay sale counts are approximate.

sources.name: eBay graded sales, via PokemonPriceTracker
sources.note: Prices of PSA-graded copies from completed eBay sales, looked up for the current picks only.

categories.title: Get 'em now

categories.rule: Singles that were $30 and up, sell often and held or gained value over the months before, now down 5% to 35% in 17 days and below their usual price over the last 90 days. From sets at least a year old, because new sets normally get cheaper after release. These are signs that often come before a price recovers, not a prediction.
